These test fixtures are copied unmodified from bfabiszewski/libmobi at revision
906274205c11944b628da1c553b255acb1af7c55, tests/samples/. See
third_party/libmobi/COPYING (LGPL-3.0-or-later).
They cover PalmDOC, HUFF/CDIC, Windows-1252, KF8 and DRM rejection.
sample-obfuscated-fonts.mobi contains a real KF8 (version 8) book and is opened
with an .azw3 suffix by the test; changing its name does not change its format.
